scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @portalivp/shared && npm run start:dev -w @portalivp/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @portalivp/shared && npm run dev -w @portalivp/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @portalivp/shared && npm run build -w @portalivp/api && npm run build -w @portalivp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @portalivp/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w @portalivp/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
